description: Submit an authenticated world proposal, challenge, evaluation, audience projection or publication request through the existing review gate. Every operation is a request/record, not automatic canon change or publication. For propose, include evidence, counterevidence, falsifier and at least two distinct dimension_changes; use returned world_id for later operations. Use explore_cassie_world to read worlds. Missing authorization/evidence is a rejection, not implicit approval.

audience_projections.description: Optional audience labels, up to 20 strings of 160 characters each.

confidence.description: Optional proposer-estimated confidence from 0 to 1; recorded as an estimate.

counterevidence.description: Counterevidence strings, up to 20 and 1000 characters each; at least one is required for propose.

dimension_changes.description: For propose, list 2–6 distinct dimensions changed from existing worlds, using only the listed enum values.

evidence.description: Optional supporting evidence records, at most 20; include source references rather than unsupported assertions.

falsifier.description: A condition that would count against the proposal, up to 2000 characters; required for propose.

genre_projections.description: Optional genre labels, up to 20 strings of 120 characters each.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable key for the operation receipt; reuse only for an identical operation and payload.

knowledge_class.description: Optional classification: founder_hypothesis, agent_hypothesis or counterfactual_world.

operation.description: Required operation: propose, challenge, evaluate, project_audience or submit_publication; non-propose operations target an existing world_id.

seed_claim.description: Proposed world's core claim, up to 2000 characters; propose requires a substantive claim.

spoiler_level.description: Optional spoiler ceiling 0–3; omit for the schema/runtime default behavior.

title.description: Optional proposed world title, up to 200 characters; used for propose.

world_id.description: Optional ID for a new proposal (server may generate one) or required target ID for other operations; obtain target IDs from explore_cassie_world.

name: govern_cassie_world
title: Propose or challenge a Cassie world
